comparison.objective: Release a safety loop and open a detent-latch bottle while keeping it upright; candidate installs a rack rail.
comparison.physical_skill: Sequential safety release and lid opening with bottle stabilization versus long-part support, spring-tab depression, paired-prong insertion, telescoping, and fastening.
comparison.success_condition: Required loop/lid angles without excessive tilt, support loss, or force versus four retained rail attachments and correct screws.
comparison.reason: Shared latch actuation is generic; the mechanisms and tested assembly outcome differ.
